review:
A 5x4 game built entirely on Infectious xWays: mystery symbols reveal a stack of one symbol and spread it to other spots, while ordinary wilds fill out the extra ways.

Three or four bonus symbols let you choose Toxic Hazard or Lock n' Load free spins, with an extra spin for four. Extreme volatility, 55,555x max – but a high 31% hit rate keeps it ticking over.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
